Temperature is a red line without point markers: break points 60, 50, 40, 20 cm plus ends 70/0 cm (0 C at x=2115 px, 46.6 px/C; the dashed air-temperature segment starts at -1.8 C = printed air temp and the line ends at 0.0 C at the ground; +-0.1 C). Site printed 'Sunshine Study Plot' while the file is in the Goat's Eye folder; transcribed as printed. The box 'Some broken results in HST' has no test code or score and is kept as a layer comment, not a test.
